legend: During the programming classes Vasya was assigned a difficult problem. However, he doesn't know how to code and was unable to find the solution in the Internet, so he asks you to help.
You are given a sequence a$$$a$$$, consisting of n$$$n$$$ distinct integers, that is used to construct the binary search tree. Below is the formal description of the construction process.
First element a1$$$a_1$$$ becomes the root of the tree.

Elements a2,a3,…,an$$$a_2, a_3, \ldots, a_n$$$ are added one by one. To add element ai$$$a_i$$$ one needs to traverse the tree starting from the root and using the following rules:   The pointer to the current node is set to the root.
If ai$$$a_i$$$ is greater than the value in the current node, then its right child becomes the current node. Otherwise, the left child of the current node becomes the new current node.
If at some point there is no required child, the new node is created, it is assigned value ai$$$a_i$$$ and becomes the corresponding child of the current node.
input: The first line of the input contains a single integer n$$$n$$$ (2≤n≤100000$$$2 \leq n \leq 100\,000$$$) — the length of the sequence a$$$a$$$.
The second line contains n$$$n$$$ distinct integers ai$$$a_i$$$ (1≤ai≤109$$$1 \leq a_i \leq 10^9$$$) — the sequence a$$$a$$$ itself.
output: Output n−1$$$n - 1$$$ integers. For all i>1$$$i  \gt  1$$$ print the value written in the node that is the parent of the node with value ai$$$a_i$$$ in it.

legend.ai: 在编程课上，Vasya 被布置了一道难题。然而，他不会编程，也无法在互联网上找到解法，所以他请求你帮助他。
给定一个序列 a$$$a$$$，其中包含 n$$$n$$$ 个互不相同的整数，该序列用于构造二叉搜索树。下面是构造过程的形式化描述。
第一个元素 a1$$$a_1$$$ 成为树的根。
元素 a2,a3,…,an$$$a_2, a_3, \ldots, a_n$$$ 依次逐个加入。为了添加元素 ai$$$a_i$$$，需要从根开始按照以下规则遍历树：将指向当前节点的指针设为根。
如果 ai$$$a_i$$$ 大于当前节点中的值，则将其右子节点设为当前节点；否则，将当前节点的左子节点设为新的当前节点。
如果某一时刻不存在所需的子节点，则创建一个新节点，将其赋值为 ai$$$a_i$$$，并令其成为当前节点对应的子节点。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$(2≤n≤100000$$$2 \leq n \leq 100\,000$$$)，表示序列 a$$$a$$$ 的长度。
第二行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个互不相同的整数 ai$$$a_i$$$(1≤ai≤109$$$1 \leq a_i \leq 10^9$$$)，表示序列 a$$$a$$$ 本身。

output.ai: 输出 n−1$$$n - 1$$$ 个整数。对于所有 i>1$$$i  \gt  1$$$，输出值为 ai$$$a_i$$$ 的节点的父节点中所写的值。
